title: Measure Test Coverage (pytest-cov, c8, JaCoCo) — Companion Resources
title_es: Medir Cobertura de Test (pytest-cov, c8, JaCoCo) — Recursos complementarios
description: Ready-to-use coverage configurations: coverage.py pyproject settings, Vitest coverage thresholds, JaCoCo Maven rules, and a GitHub Actions workflow that merges parallel coverage and enforces a gate.
